title: Nice frame but there are some flaws.
text:
Nice frame but there are some flaws.. The frame itself is really nice. The excessive staples on the back holding paper in place (to cover the metal hangers and such)are a bit ridiculous. I can’t get the staples out without scratching up the back of the frame. And there’s almost 20 staples!!! So that’s dumb.

Also- it’s not a glass front (no big deal) but the plastic covering has a crease in it... so it’s damaged. But I am too lazy to return it because I don’t want to wait.
